1.0.1
https://github.com/mcmilk/7-Zip-zstd/tree/master/C/fast-lzma2

Apart from the changes below and line endings, the files are official fast-lzma2 1.0.1
(https://github.com/conor42/fast-lzma2, tag v1.0.1).

GrindCore (audit/native-fixes, audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1):
- lzma2_enc.c, radix_engine.h, radix_internal.h and radix_mf.c are upstream master's (967306d3), i.e. 1.0.1 plus
  b44b79b9 ("Fix unsafe access to the match table in struct LZMA2_ECtx_s") and a793db99 ("Don't read beyond end
  in RMF_handleRepeat"). Neither changes the compressed output.
- fl2_decompress.c: FL2_decompressDCtx rejects a 0-byte source (marked [audit fix, audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1]).
- fl2_pool.c: FL2POOL_waitAll counts a queued job as busy, so a timed wait no longer reports completion before the
  job has started (marked [audit fix, audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1]).
- lzma2_dec.c: after a dictionary reset, an LZMA chunk without properties is rejected, as 7-Zip's Lzma2Dec
  rejects it, and the default pb is set (it set lc twice); a crafted chunk was decoded with pb unset (marked
  [audit fix, audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1 finding 11]; unfixed upstream).
- lzma2_dec.c: a chunk's last bytes are decoded from a zero-padded copy, and the fast loop keeps
  LZMA_REQUIRED_INPUT_MAX bytes in hand in both finish modes, so a corrupt chunk is no longer read up to 19 bytes
  past its end (marked [audit fix, audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1 finding 10]; unfixed upstream).
- fl2_compress.c: FL2_estimateCStreamSize checks the level as FL2_estimateCCtxSize does (marked [audit fix,
  audit/other-codecs.md 4.4.1 finding 8]; unfixed upstream).
